---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for this project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## 🔄 Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📱 User Impact
- **Target Users**: [e.g. Hebrew scholars, students, researchers]
- **Use Case**: [e.g. Batch processing multiple texts]
- **Frequency**: [e.g. Daily, Weekly, Monthly]
- **Priority**: [High/Medium/Low]

## 🎨 UI/UX Considerations
- [ ] Requires new UI components
- [ ] Affects existing UI
- [ ] Mobile responsive needed
- [ ] Accessibility considerations
- [ ] RTL support needed

## 🔧 Technical Considerations
- [ ] Backend changes required
- [ ] Database schema changes
- [ ] API modifications
- [ ] Performance impact
- [ ] Security implications

## 📊 Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Feature works as described
- [ ] All languages supported
- [ ] Mobile responsive
- [ ] Accessibility compliant
- [ ] Performance acceptable
- [ ] Security reviewed

## 📸 Mockups/Wireframes
If applicable, add mockups or wireframes to help explain the feature.

## 🔗 Related Issues
Link to any related issues or discussions.

## 📋 Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have provided clear acceptance criteria
- [ ] I have considered technical implications
- [ ] I have considered user experience impact

## 🏷️ Labels
- [ ] `enhancement`
- [ ] `ui/ux` (if UI related)
- [ ] `performance` (if performance related)
- [ ] `security` (if security related)
- [ ] `i18n` (if internationalization related)
